propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Beatae Mariae Magdalenae, quaesumus, Domine, suffragiis adjuvemur: cujus
precibus exoratus, quatriduanum fratrem Lazarum vivum ab inferis
resuscitasti: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

The locus is this feast's own day in that witness (8 lines from its printed name). This reading was confirmed word for word on the Tours Mame PAGE IMAGE (artifact PDF p. 778 rendered at 300 dpi), not only on its text layer. NOT checked: the antecedent's pointing beyond what its text layer prints, and the 1604 and 1570, which were not consulted for this oration because two independent public-domain witnesses already carry it.
